example_lines: 'You want the pocket on the left. You always reach left. I watched you. Left pocket.'
'I can do what you're describing but it's going to fight the fabric every day you wear it and eventually the fabric wins. Up to you.'

story_hooks: A client came in for alterations to a coat and left without it â€” abandoned it mid-appointment and hasn't returned. The coat has a concealed lining she didn't construct. She's curious about what's in it and whether she should be.

Someone is trying to set up a competing shop on Stitch Row with prices that are impossible unless they're subsidized â€” and they're specifically undercutting her specialty services. She wants to know why.
The ceremonial garment under the counter â€” she's received word that her mother is ill. Now she has to decide whether to send it, deliver it herself, or do nothing.

decision_rules: The work has to be right â€” she will redo something rather than release it flawed

escalation_ladder: Stop engaging and let the silence work

timeline.event: Born in Old Harbor to a Malian-descended mother and Russian-descended father
